'''Nat Lariats''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Old Jedi Order]] during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During a light sword exercise in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she was approached by her classmate [[Nuru Kungurama]], who gave her his practice light sword and ran away without giving her time to ask questions.<ref name="Breakout Squad" />
